name: CUREWAX Ear Drops 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About CUREWAX EAR DROPS

CUREWAX Ear Drops is an ear preparation indicated in the management of ear wax removal. It softens and clears impacted ear wax and relieves ear pain and discomfort associated with any ear conditions. It also eliminates bacterial and fungal ear infections and manages it from worsening.

It contains Paradichlorobenzene, Benzocaine, Chlorbutol and Turpentine as active ingredients. Paradichlorobenzene dissolves and expels ear wax while exerting antibacterial properties. Benzocaine is an analgesic medication. It numbs the ear cavity and provides relief from ear pain and discomfort.

Chlorbutol is a preservative with anti-bacterial and anti-fungal properties. It manages further ear infection and turpentine oil lubricates the ear cavity and helps in removal of impacted ear wax.

Use CUREWAX Ear Drops as advised by your physician. Gently instil few drops of CUREWAX Ear Drops into the affected ears. Do not use CUREWAX Ear Drops if you are allergic to any of its ingredients or have otitis externa, seborrheic dermatitis or eczema affecting ears. The most common side effects of using CUREWAX Ear Drops are ear irritation and dizziness.

name: Clearwax Ear Drops 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About CLEARWAX EAR DROPS

CLEARWAX EAR DROPS is a combination of Paradichlorobenzene, Benzocaine, Chlorbutol and Turpentine Oil which belongs to the group of medicines called Otic agents, Local anaesthetics, Wax softeners and Lubricating agent. It is indicated in the patients who have impacted wax and keratosis (build-up of keratin in the ear canal).

CLEARWAX EAR DROPS should be used with caution in patients having kidney and liver diseases, hearing problems, intestinal problems, myasthenia gravis and Parkinson’s disease. CLEARWAX EAR DROPS is not recommended for use in children below 1 year of age.

Caution must be exercised while using CLEARWAX EAR DROPS in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor’s advice to use CLEARWAX EAR DROPS in elderly patients. The most common side effects of using CLEARWAX EAR DROPS are sleepiness and headache. Talk with your doctor if any of these worsen or does not improve.

Used to manage impacted ear wax and keratosis
mechanismOfAction:
How CLEARWAX EAR DROPS Works

CLEARWAX EAR DROPS aids in the management of impacted ear wax and keratosis where, Benzocaine belongs to Local anaesthetic which acts on certain nerve pathways and decreases the pain sensation. Paradichlorobenzene acts by reducing the thickness of the impacted wax, facilitating its easy removal. Chlorbutol acts as a wax softener and Turpentine oil removes the dryness and lubricates the ear canal.

How to use CLEARWAX EAR DROPS

Use CLEARWAX EAR DROPS as advised by your doctor. It is for external use only. Instil 2-3 drops of CLEARWAX EAR DROPS in affected ear 3-4 times a day or as directed by physician. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the condition.

name: WAXONIL O Ear Drops 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About WAXONIL O EAR DROPS

WAXONIL O Ear Drops is used for impacted ear wax removal. It helps to soften and remove the hardened ear wax from the ear canal. It contains virgin olive oil as an active ingredient which is a liquid fat extracted from the ripe fruits of olive tree.

Olive oil contains emollient and lubricating properties. It works by softening and loosening the earwax, making it easier to remove. It also helps in reducing ear dryness, irritation and inflammation caused by impacted earwax.

WAXONIL O Ear Drops is suitable for use in children and in adults. It is meant for using only in the ears. Consult your doctor if you don’t see any improvement in your condition after completion of suggested therapy duration.

Talk to your doctor before using WAXONIL O Ear Drops if you are allergic to Virgin Olive oil, have a previous history of ear problems, have undergone ear syringing in the last 2-3 days, have damage in the ear drum, suffer from dizziness, ringing sound in the ears or have ear infection, pain, swelling or discharge for the ears.

WAXONIL O Ear Drops can be used during pregnancy and breastfeeding if recommended by the physician. The most common side effects of using WAXONIL O Ear Drops are cloggy ears and discomfort. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Used for impacted ear wax removal
usesDetails:
Uses Of WAXONIL O EAR DROPS
Used for impacted ear wax removal
mechanismOfAction:
How WAXONIL O EAR DROPS Works

WAXONIL O Ear Drops contains Virgin olive oil which works by softening and loosening earwax, making it easier to remove. Olive oil acts as an emollient, penetrating hardened earwax (cerumen) and reducing its density, which helps facilitate its natural expulsion from the ear canal. By softening the earwax, the oil aids in its movement from the inner ear to the outer ear, where it can be easily wiped away. This softening process alleviates discomfort and can prevent blockage, improving hearing and overall ear health.

Additionally, the lubricating properties of olive oil reduce irritation and dryness in the ear canal. Olive oil's mild anti-inflammatory effects can soothe any inflammation caused by impacted earwax, providing relief from discomfort.
usageDetails:
How to use WAXONIL O EAR DROPS

Use WAXONIL O EAR DROPS as advised by your doctor. It is meant for using only in the ears. Gently instil few drops of this medicine into the affected ears once or twice daily.

Avoid contact of WAXONIL O EAR DROPS with your eyes. In case of accidental contact, rinse your eyes with plenty of water for 10-15 minutes. Talk to your doctor if irritation persists.

WAXONIL O EAR DROPS will be prescribed up to the maximum of 2 weeks. Consult your doctor if you don’t see any improvement in your condition after completion of suggested therapy duration.

name: OTOGON Ear Drops 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About OTOGON EAR DROPS

OTOGON EAR DROPS is a combination of Lidocaine and Phenazone which belongs to the group of medicines called Local Anesthetics and Analgesic and anesthetic agents respectively. It is intended for local symptomatic management and relief of pain in the diseases of the middle ear without tympanic perforation. It is also used to manage acute inflammation of the middle ear, middle ear inflammation as a complication after flu, and barotraumatic damage of the middle ear (barotraumatic otitis).

OTOGON EAR DROPS is not recommended to use in patients who have or had perforated or burst ear drum (tympanic perforation) and chronic otitis media.

OTOGON EAR DROPS should be used with caution among pregnant and breastfeeding women OTOGON EAR DROPS should be used with caution in children, infants, and elderly patients.

The most common side effect of this medicine is vertigo, nausea, and involuntary eye movements. Contact your physician if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Otitis as a complication after the flu
usesDetails:
Uses Of OTOGON EAR DROPS

It is used to manage local symptomatic management of:

Acute otitis media
Otitis as a complication after the flu
Barotraumatic otitis
mechanismOfAction:
How OTOGON EAR DROPS Works

OTOGON EAR DROPS is a combination of Lidocaine and Phenazone where Lidocaine is a local anesthetic that stops the sodium ions from passing through the voltage-gated channels so signals for pain are stopped even before the signal is formed by blocking the conduction of nerve impulses. Phenazone works by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers (prostaglandins) that cause fever, pain, and inflammation (redness and swelling).
usageDetails:
How to use OTOGON EAR DROPS

Use OTOGON EAR DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition. Check the label for directions before use.
sideEffects: Itching, burning, redness, oozing sores in the ear
Local allergic reactions (symptoms like itching, maculopapular rash)

name: Soliwax Ear Drops 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About SOLIWAX EAR DROPS

Soliwax Ear Drops is an ear wax softening agent, used in patients with impacted ear wax (stuffed up sensation, dulled hearing, and associated ear pain). It contains benzocaine, chlorbutol, paradichlorobenzene and turpentine oil as an active ingredients which dissolves ear wax and relieves ear discomfort.

Paradichlorobenzene is a hydrating agent which reduces the thickness of the earwax. Chlorbutol acts as a wax softener. Turpentine oil is a lubricating agent which facilitates easy removal of the wax from ear. Benzocaine acts as a local anaesthetic. Together, they relieve the earache promptly, exerting insecticidal, antibacterial, and anti-fungal actions simultaneously.

Always use Soliwax Ear Drops as advised by the physician. It is for external use only. Do not exceed the daily recommended dosage. Position the patient on their side with ear affected on upside and instil five to ten drops. Place a cotton plug and leave it there for 15 to 30 minutes. Utilize a cotton swab to remove the softened wax from the ear canal. Manage the other ear canal in the same way if it's also affected.
sideEffectsDetails:

Consult your doctor if you notice any unusual side effects while using Soliwax Ear Drops.

Introduction About DISOVEX EAR DROPS

DISOVEX EAR DROPS is a combination of Paradichlorobenzene, Benzocaine, Chlorbutol and Turpentine Oil which belongs to the group of medicines called Otic agents, Local anaesthetics, Wax softeners and Lubricating agent. It is indicated in the patients who have impacted wax and keratosis (build-up of keratin in the ear canal).

DISOVEX EAR DROPS should be used with caution in patients having kidney and liver diseases, hearing problems, intestinal problems, myasthenia gravis and Parkinson’s disease. DISOVEX EAR DROPS is not recommended for use in children below 1 year of age.

Caution must be exercised while using DISOVEX EAR DROPS in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor’s advice to use DISOVEX EAR DROPS in elderly patients. The most common side effects of using DISOVEX EAR DROPS are sleepiness and headache. Talk with your doctor if any of these worsen or does not improve.

name: SOLIWAX A Ear Drops 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About SOLIWAX A EAR DROPS

Soliwax A Ear Drops is a lubricant and softener, used to dissolve ear wax in patients with impacted ear wax (Stuffed up sensation, dulled hearing, and associated ear pain). It contains Virgin Almond oil as an active ingredient which dissolves ear wax and relieves ear discomfort.

Virgin Almond oil relieves earache promptly and begins to emulsify and disperse the excess cerumen while exerting insecticidal, antibacterial and anti-fungal actions simultaneously and easy removal of wax.

Always use Soliwax A Ear Drops as advised by the physician. It is for external use only. Position the patient on their side, ear affected up. 2-3 drops of Soliwax should be inserted into each ear. Gently massage in front of the ear. Place a cotton plug in the midline and leave it there for 15 to 30 minutes. Utilize a cotton swab to remove the softened cerumen from the ear canal. Repeat the other ear if necessary. Not to be used in children below 1 year of age.
author: Dr. Dhivakaran R

name: SOLIWAX CP Ear Drops 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About SOLIWAX CP EAR DROPS

Soliwax-CP Ear Drops provides microfoam cleansing action to remove excess ear wax. It contains carbamide as active ingredients for fast and easy removal of excessive ear wax in a gentle and non-irritating method.         

Carbamide contains cerumenolytic agent which is used to soften and break down earwax. It works by penetrating the wax and breaking its structure to naturally drain ear wax from the ear.  

Always use Soliwax-CP Ear Drops as advised by the doctor. It is for external use only. For usage, instil 5-10 drops into the affected ear(s) 2 times daily for up to 4 days or as directed by doctor. It should not be used below 12 years of age.
author: Dr. R. Dinesh John Rajkumar

name: DREP WAX Ear Drops 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About DREP WAX EAR DROPS

Drep Wax Ear Drops is a medicine that is used to manage blocked and impacted ears due to the presence of ear wax. It has Turpentine oil, Chlorbutol, Benzocaine and Paradichlorobenzene as the active ingredients that aid in dissolving the ear wax and manage bacterial and fungal infections.

Paradichlorobenzene aids in the removal of ear wax by reducing the thickness of ear wax. It also acts as a hydrating agent. Chlorbutol softens the ear wax. Turpentine oil lubricates the ear. Benzocaine acts as a local anaesthetic agent and numbs the pain associated with it.

Drep Wax Ear Drops is to be used as directed by the doctor. It is only for external usage. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage of Drep Wax Ear Drops. Consult your doctor if you notice any allergic reactiosn while using Drep Wax Ear Drops.
author: Dr. Priyanka Goel

name: WAXNIL EAR WAX Drops 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About WAXNIL EAR WAX DROPS

Waxnil Ear Wax Drops is a specially designed non-irritating and smoothening formulation that helps to remove hardened ear wax reduces the need for syringing and relieves ear pain.  It contains Benzocaine, Chlorbutol, Paradichlorobenzene, Turpine oil as active ingredients that help to soften the hardened ear wax, reduce ear inflammation and pain.

Benzocaine acts as an anaesthetic agent that helps to relieve ear pain by blocking chemical messengers in the brain that regulate pain. Chlorbutol acts as a wax softener. Paradichlorobenzene acts as a hydrating agent, and it helps to reduce the thickness of ear wax and helps to remove wax. Turpine oil acts as a lubricating agent.

Always use Waxnil Ear Wax Drops exactly as advised by your doctor. It is for external use only. Tilt your head, and gently squeeze five drops into the affected ear, leave for a few minutes and then wipe the surplus with a tissue. Wash your hands after use. Repeat once or twice daily. Do not exceed the daily recommended dosage.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of WAXNIL EAR WAX DROPS

It may cause headache, sleeplessness, allergic reactions (anaphylaxis) in some individuals. consult a doctor if you experience any unusual symptoms while using Waxnil Ear Wax Drops.

name: WAXSOFT Drops 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About WAXSOFT DROPS

Waxsoft Drops are used to soften and easily remove the hardened ear wax from the ear canal and relieve the discomfort and fullness associated with it. Waxsoft Drops contains Sodium bicarbonate as active ingredients that soften the wax facilitates its easy removal.

Sodium bicarbonate tend gently soften the earwax and encourage the ear wax to get dislodged from the ear canal and naturally fall while laying down.

Use Waxsoft Drops exactly as advised by the doctor. It is for external use only (only ears). Tilt your head and gently release 3 to 4 drops in the ear using the provided dropper. Avoid touching the dropper with the ear. Repeat the process in another ear, if needed. Wash your hands after using Waxsoft Drops. Do not exceed the recommended dosage of the medicine. Do not touch the dropper tip.
